info.notes: Pass exactly196 bytes to PG_GetInfo; compare returned abi1/bytes196. GUID fields are Windows SDK layout, can journal exact16bytes/bytes_le UUID representation. PG_INFO contains no native handle or cleanup capability.

ABI.return_semantics: ERROR_SUCCESS0 means that particular operation succeeded, never Native/support/network admission. PG_Poison returns0 after marking ORPHAN and retaining reason in last_error; a zero reason becomes ERROR_INVALID_DATA. Other failures return the actual Win32/WFP code (CoCreateGuid failure conservatively ERROR_GEN_FAILURE). PG_AbandonAndFree0 only means local handle/memory disposal, never policy removal or cleanup completion.

root_call_sequence: Existing AppContainerLaunch must create exactly one fresh profile with only S_OK, validate real SID, preserve profile/storage/source/tool identity. PG_Create accepts only an actual base package SID (authority15,RID2,8subauthorities,40bytes), not a saved SID or existing profile. CI environment gates remain additional non-authenticating checks.

PG_Create(actual_SID_buffer,40,&owner); immediately PG_GetInfo. C has not opened BFE or changed policy. Python durably journals fresh profile/name, actual SID, these five owned keys, source/controller/DLL/tool pins and host-only canonical ownership BEFORE PG_Arm. Journal/profile/source binding deliberately stays outside C; C does not pretend it verified a journal.

PG_Arm(owner): local non-dynamic engine, bounded2s transaction lock wait; add persistent custom sublayer+4fixed SID-only BLOCK filters in one transaction with protected exact SYSTEM/Administrators DACLs, commit and policy/security readback. Any error poisons owner. Copy/flush ARMED host state before any child creation.

Existing _run_job creates its unnamed Job and sets original limits. PG_RegisterJob(owner,actual_hJob,&job_slot) BEFORE process creation; C verifies kill-on-close/no breakaway and stores a noninheritable same-object duplicate. Slots0/1 are live-owner values only, not original handle-value lookup or serialized authority.

Immediately BEFORE every fallible CreateProcess call, PG_BeginCreate(owner,job_slot). This latches pending_create. There is deliberately no reset/cancel-creation API. On CreateProcess success, PG_RegisterProcess(owner,job_slot,actual_hProcess,&process_slot) BEFORE any fallible callback/assignment/token operation. Successful duplicate/store clears pending; failure poisons.

Existing runner still assigns actual process to exact Job, checks suspended token AppContainer SID and zero capabilities, checks source/tool/ACL/guard contract. PG_BeforeResume(owner,process_slot) additionally rechecks exact policy/security and actual retained process membership in retained Job, once per registered process. Only then call existing ResumeThread.

ANY CreateProcess/registration/duplicate/callback/assignment/token/ResumeThread or ownership uncertainty MUST call PG_Poison before propagating. This includes Python exceptions outside C, even when existing runner later proves cleanup. Do not infer safe absence from an empty registered Job or unset _outstanding. A pending or poisoned owner can never reach deletion.

After sequential runs, finish original tool/source/material checks, irreversibly stop launch authority, and PG_SealLaunches. Existing runner must have terminated/waited its actual Jobs/processes as required. Counters/old receipts are not the deletion proof; retained C handles stay live until final removal decision.

PG_RemoveWhenEmpty: begin transaction; exact policy/security readback; require at least one retained Job, every actual Job query ActiveProcesses0, and every registered controller-created process signalled. Then delete exactly4filters and own sublayer, commit, independently open another non-dynamic engine and require exact FILTER_NOT_FOUND/SUBLAYER_NOT_FOUND for each key. Any nonzero/unknown error poisons with no retry/unconditional deletion.

Record C info before freeing. Existing Python context separately completes/verifies original DACL restoration, profile deletion/storage absence and source/tool evidence. Keep copied SID valid; do not treat PG_REMOVED alone as full cleanup. Permanent name/SID tombstone remains.

PG_AbandonAndFree(&owner) closes only local engine/retained handles and zeroes/frees owner; NO filter, sublayer, profile, file or journal deletion. On error/poison/crash, remaining persistent policy and host state are retained forever for this SID. No later invocation adopts/reuses/removes it, regardless of PID observations or old ZERO receipt.

C_guarantees_by_inspection_not_test.failure: Mutation/commit uncertainty sets conservative policy_may_exist. Failed add/commit attempts transaction abort and records abort_error, but never unconditionally deletes/rolls forward. Any poison is irreversible. Removal transaction rollback/commit/absence uncertainties retain ORPHAN; already deleted objects are not recreated or reported as retained.
